name: Pattern Listener
subject: Psychology
headline: A newborn’s brain is already listening for the pattern.
hook: Babies just days old already notice sound patterns.
found: Their brains tracked repeats in syllables and in voices, even when the other kept changing.
matters: We may be born with a pattern finder that helps us learn to talk.

name: Tiny Gardener
subject: Biology
headline: A yak’s best friend might be a tiny gardener.
hook: Pika, called pests, may be a yak’s best friend.
found: Yaks gained more weight where some pika lived, because pika clip a poisonous plant.
matters: Wiping out a “pest” can backfire on the animals we care about.

name: Babbling Bat
subject: Biology
headline: Baby bats may benefit from more than a song playlist.
hook: Baby bats babble, just like human babies.
found: Pups with more involved mothers practiced longer and sounded more grown-up.
matters: Learning to talk may lean on caring parents in many animals.

name: Color Number
subject: Psychology
headline: A gray number can make an eye react to color.
hook: For some people, a gray number looks colored.
found: Their pupils reacted to the color they experienced, though the screen stayed gray.
matters: The colors are real enough that the body responds to them.

name: Footprint Comeback
subject: Earth science
headline: Ancient footprints reveal life rebuilding after disaster.
hook: Ancient footprints show life bouncing back after disaster.
found: Two million years after the worst mass extinction, rivers held a rich community again.
matters: Recovery after catastrophe can be faster than we thought.

name: Shark Toolbox
subject: Biology
headline: A shark’s whole toolbox tells more than one tooth.
hook: One shark tooth is a clue; the whole mouth tells the story.
found: The mix of teeth across a jaw revealed where a shark lived.
matters: Fossil hunters can read habitats from tooth sets, not single teeth.

name: Neighbor Alarm
subject: Chemistry
headline: A plant can pick up its neighbor’s chemical alarm.
hook: A plant can hear its neighbor scream, by smell.
found: An undamaged maize plant reacted to a chewed neighbor’s airborne chemicals.
matters: Plants may warn each other before pests arrive.

name: Spider Memory
subject: Biology
headline: A tiny spider may remember who it has met.
hook: A tiny loner spider may remember who it has met.
found: Jumping spiders told a familiar spider from a stranger.
matters: Big social smarts can fit in a very small brain.

name: Striped Farm
subject: Earth science
headline: A striped farm can bring more beetles to the table.
hook: Stripes of crops can bring more beetles to dinner.
found: Fields with alternating crop strips held a richer mix of ground beetles.
matters: Simple planting changes can help helpful insects.

name: Poison Cocktail
subject: Chemistry
headline: Even a poison specialist can struggle with the cocktail.
hook: Even a poison expert can choke on the cocktail.
found: Monarch caterpillars that handle one milkweed poison struggled with a mixture.
matters: Handling one danger is not the same as handling many.
